title: French With Panache - Interesting Conversations in Real French
author: Violaine Prior & Nathan Mergy
description: French With Panache is a podcast of authentic conversations about culture, society, and everyday life in France. Hosted by Violaine and Nathan, journalists and French teachers. For intermediate and advanced learners who want to understand how French is really spoken. 🌐 https://frenchwithpanache.com Hébergé par Ausha. Visitez ausha.co/fr/politique-de-confidentialite pour plus d'informations.

extraits.texte: Great podcast, many many thanks! A few small suggestions if you don’t mind. 1) consider speaking at your regular pace instead of slowing down for the learners. People can always slow down the podcast or re-listen; otherwise you lose your advanced speakers.…

A fantastically enjoyable way to perfect/improve your grasp of French. Mine is passable (school and holidays) and I’ve long wanted to get better but I struggle to get into the dryness of apps like babbel etc, whereas listening to this pod is actually a pleasant experience …

I recently found this podcast and found it very interesting, good to practice listening skills for intermediate level students with good topics, not the regular and boring topics you found in a language podcast.…
